title: Oracle Answer for Circuit Edges
statement: Let $C$ be a family of Boolean circuits with $n$ input vertices, and let $u,v$ be natural numbers. The edge oracle, queried with the encoding of $n$ and the pair of binary encodings of $u$ and $v$, returns true exactly when $u$ is an argument of the gate at vertex $v$ in the circuit for input length $n$; equivalently, its Boolean answer is the indicator of that edge relation.
